executive_profile.heading: EXECUTIVE PROFILE:
executive_profile.content: Senior Sales & Distribution Leader with 20+ years of experience building, scaling, and professionalizing FMCG and Consumer Health (OTC) businesses. Proven track record of Go-To-Market, Market entry, driving revenue growth, profitability, and cash discipline across GT, MT, and E-commerce, with deep expertise in distribution expansion, channel economics, and operating governance. Experienced in startup-to-scale journeys, PE-backed environments, and structured organizations; bringing a system-led, data-driven, and people-centric leadership approach.
